name: 小糸
text:
あ……
雛菜ちゃんも行く？
trans:
Ah......
You wanna tag along, Hinana?

name: 雛菜
text:
うん～！
でも教室寄ってから～
trans:
Sure～!
But I need to drop by the classroom first～

name: 小糸
text:
そっか
じゃあわたしも……
trans:
Ah ok.
Then I'll come along with......

name: 小糸
text:
──透ちゃん、円香ちゃん
先に行ってて……！

name: 透
text:
樋口も？
クリームパン
trans:
You want it too, Higuchi?
The cream bun.

name: 円香
text: この間、売り切れてたから
trans: Cos it sold out the other day.

name: 円香
text: 浅倉はよく食べてるでしょ
trans: You eat this quite often, don't you, Asakura?

name: 円香
text:
他のにしたら
今日は
trans:
Why don't you go for something else,
just for today?

name: 透
text:
食べてないから
最近
trans:
But I haven't had this for a while now,
recently.

name: 円香
text:
最近っていつ？
昨日？

name: 透
trans:
I'm not sure.
Probably since a while ago.

name: 円香
trans: A reminder that you owe me 500yen from that day.

name: 透
trans: But, you borrowed from me too.

name: 円香
trans:
You thought that the 500yen debt was absolved
from that?

name: 円香
trans: It'd be weird if it did.

name: 円香
text:
だからここは
譲るっていうのも、アリ
trans:
And so, asking you to give it up this time is
completely reasonable.

name: 透
text:
食べたい？
クリームパン
trans:
Do you wanna eat it?
The cream bun.

name: 円香
text:
別に……
めっちゃってほどじゃない
trans:
But not that much......
At least not to the extent that I super want it.

name: 透
text:
じゃ
もらっていい？
trans:
Then,
It's fine that I have it, right?

name: 円香
trans: No, that's not how it works.

name: 円香
trans: Do you wanna eat it then, Asakura?

name: 透
text:
え？　うん
めっ……ちゃ

name: 円香
trans: Then, can you let me have it?

name: 透
text:
ふふっ
欲しいってことか、めっ……ちゃ
trans:
Hehe. So you're saying that you do want it...
Like, suu-...per.

name: 透
text:
オッケー
じゃ、貸し１
trans:
Okayー
Then, you're gonna owe me one.

name: 円香
text:
他のにするから
どうぞ
trans: I'll have something else, so go ahead.

name: 雛菜
text:
クリームパン残ってた！
最後のひとつ～！
trans:
They still have a cream bun left!
The last one, too～!

name: 雛菜
text:
すみません～！
お会計お願いします────
trans:
Excuse me～!
I'd like to pay for this────

name: 小糸
text:
ご、ごめんね……！
ちょっと遅くなっちゃった
trans:
I-I'm sorry......!
We were a little late.

name: 小糸
text:
欲しいのあった？
もう買っちゃった……？
trans:
Did you find anything you want?
Or have you already bought your them......?
